description: This file contains a custom matcher class for Espresso tests in Android, specifically designed to identify Toast messages in UI tests.

classes.name: ToastMatcher
classes.description: A utility class extending TypeSafeMatcher to identify Toast messages in Espresso tests by matching root windows of type TYPE_TOAST that are top-level windows.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a description of the matcher for test failure messages.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Contains the logic to determine whether the given Root window matches the criteria for a Toast message.
